_como_usar: Inglês. Mesma estrutura de data/info.json: contatos e preços mudam lá e aqui juntos.
endereco: Estrada do Bairro dos Mellos, km 4
checkinObs: Arriving after 8pm? Let us know on WhatsApp: the key is in a lockbox on the door and the code is sent by message.

regras.texto: Not allowed, to keep both cabins quiet.
The cabins are designed for couples and are not set up for children.
Only the guests on the booking.
Outdoors only, away from the forest.

cancelamento: Cancel up to 15 days before and the deposit is refunded in full. After that, it becomes credit for another date within 6 months.

conexao.wifi: Satellite Wi-Fi, good for messages and video.
conexao.celular: Vivo and Claro work on the porch; TIM is patchy.

estrada: The last 4 km are packed dirt and fine for low cars in dry weather. When it rains, drive slowly and try to arrive before dark.

feriados._obs: Feriados nacionais com preço de feriado.

novosChales._obs: Faixa da lista dos primeiros, mostrada enquanto houver chalé com status "oculto". mostrar: false esconde a faixa.
novosChales.vantagem: People on the list get 15% off their first stay.

disponibilidade._obs: Usado pelo simulador de reserva. fonte: "planilha", "ical" ou as duas.

faq.pergunta: Is breakfast included in the nightly rate?
faq.resposta: No. It comes in a basket, as an extra, delivered to your cabin door at the time you choose.
Yes. The key is in a lockbox on the door and the code is sent on WhatsApp. Just let us know your expected arrival time.

faq.pergunta: How do I pay the deposit?
faq.resposta: By Pix or card. The deposit is half the total and the rest is paid on arrival.

faq.pergunta: Can we bring food and cook in the cabin?
faq.resposta: Yes. Every cabin has a compact kitchen with a cooktop, minibar, pots and dishes.
Yes, a covered space next to each cabin.

faq.pergunta: Can we go hiking from the cabins?
faq.resposta: Yes. There is a short trail to the lookout on the property, and the longer mountain trails are a few minutes away by car.
